name: Azure
certifications: AZ-204: Developing Solutions for Microsoft Azure
AZ-305: Designing Microsoft Azure Infrastructure Solutions

beginner.summary: No cloud experience assumed. Participants learn the core Azure services for identity, compute, storage, networking, databases and monitoring, and deploy a small web application.
prerequisites: Basic computer and networking knowledge (IP address, DNS, web browser)
An Azure subscription or trainer-provided sandbox with a budget alert
outcomes: Explain cloud computing, Azure global infrastructure and the shared responsibility model
Organise resources with management groups, subscriptions, resource groups and tags
Deploy and secure virtual machines, storage accounts, virtual networks and Azure SQL
Deploy, monitor and cost-control a simple web application on Azure

days.topic: Cloud Computing Concepts and Azure Global Infrastructure
subtopics: What cloud computing is: on-demand, pay-as-you-go
Azure regions, region pairs and availability zones
Creating a subscription and signing in
The Azure portal, Cloud Shell and Azure CLI
Pricing calculator and free account limits
Creating a budget alert in Cost Management
days.lab_task: Set up a subscription for training: create a budget of 10 USD with an email alert, open Cloud Shell, and choose a region and its pair with a written reason.
days.deliverable: Screenshots of the budget alert and Cloud Shell session, plus a region choice note
checks: A 10 USD budget with an email alert exists
Run az account show in Cloud Shell
Ask: who patches the operating system of an Azure VM?
Participant answers the customer, citing the shared responsibility model
objectives: Explain cloud service and deployment models
Describe regions, region pairs and availability zones
Protect a new subscription with a budget

days.topic: Microsoft Entra ID Users, Groups and Role-Based Access
subtopics: Azure RBAC: roles, scopes and assignments
Checking access with the IAM blade
days.lab_task: Create Admins and Developers groups, give Developers the Reader role on one resource group, and prove a developer cannot delete a storage account in it.
days.deliverable: Group and role assignment screenshots and the denied delete attempt
checks: Developer lists resources in the resource group
Explain the scope of the role assignment
Participant explains inheritance from resource group to resources
objectives: Manage users and groups in Microsoft Entra ID
Assign Azure RBAC roles at the right scope

days.topic: Resource Groups, Subscriptions and Azure Resource Manager
subtopics: Management group, subscription and resource group hierarchy
days.lab_task: Create dev and test resource groups with naming and tagging standards, add a delete lock to test, and show that the lock stops a delete.
days.deliverable: Naming and tagging standard, resource group list and lock test result
checks: Delete is blocked by the lock
Filter resources by the project tag
Participant places each level correctly with an example
objectives: Organise resources in the Azure hierarchy

days.topic: Azure Virtual Machines
subtopics: Disks: OS and data, Standard and Premium SSD
Connecting with SSH, RDP and Azure Bastion
days.lab_task: Create an Ubuntu VM with a script extension that installs a web server, connect through Bastion with no public SSH port, and show the web page.
days.deliverable: VM details, connection screenshot and the web page
checks: Browse to the VM public IP on port 80
Try SSH to the public IP on port 22
Connection is refused because the port is closed
Stop the VM in the OS, then deallocate it in the portal
Participant explains which state still costs money
objectives: Create and connect to Azure VMs securely
Explain VM availability and pricing options

days.topic: Azure Storage Accounts and Blob Storage
subtopics: Storage account types and redundancy: LRS, ZRS, GRS
days.lab_task: Create a storage account with versioning and soft delete, upload and overwrite a file, restore the old version, and share one blob with a 15-minute SAS.
days.deliverable: Storage settings, version history and SAS test results
checks: Open the blob URL without a SAS
Open the SAS URL within 15 minutes
Delete a blob and restore it
Blob is recovered through soft delete
objectives: Store data in Azure Blob Storage
Protect data with versioning and soft delete
Share data safely with SAS tokens

days.topic: Azure Virtual Networks and Network Security Groups
days.lab_task: Build a VNet with web and app subnets, apply NSGs so only the web subnet can reach the app subnet on port 8080, and peer it to a second VNet.
days.deliverable: Network diagram, NSG rules and connectivity test results
checks: From the web VM, call the app VM on 8080
From the internet, call the app VM
From the peered VNet, reach the web VM private IP

days.topic: Azure Load Balancer and Virtual Machine Scale Sets
subtopics: Azure Load Balancer: public and internal
days.lab_task: Put a web scale set behind a public load balancer across zones with CPU-based autoscale, then delete one instance and watch it get replaced.
days.deliverable: Load balancer and scale set configuration with the scaling history
checks: Refresh the load balancer IP several times
Responses come from more than one instance
Scale set returns to the desired count
objectives: Distribute traffic with Azure Load Balancer

days.topic: Azure App Service Web Apps
subtopics: Deploying from Git or a ZIP file
days.lab_task: Deploy a web app to App Service, add a staging slot, deploy version 2 to staging, test it, and swap it into production.
days.deliverable: App URLs for both slots, slot settings and swap evidence
checks: Shows version 2 while production shows version 1
Mark one setting as a slot setting and swap
That setting stays with its slot
objectives: Host web apps on App Service

days.topic: Azure SQL Database
subtopics: Deployment options: single database, elastic pool, managed instance
days.lab_task: Create an Azure SQL database reachable only through a private endpoint, connect from the app VM, create a table and restore a point-in-time copy.
days.deliverable: Database configuration, connection test and restore evidence
checks: Connection fails because public access is disabled
Restore to a time before a row was deleted

days.topic: Azure Cosmos DB
subtopics: When to choose Cosmos DB or Azure SQL
days.lab_task: Design an Orders container partitioned by customer ID, load sample data, and query one customer's orders, comparing request unit charges with a cross-partition query.
days.deliverable: Container design note, queries and request unit comparison
checks: Run a cross-partition query for the same data
Higher request unit charge is shown
Set a TTL of 60 seconds on a test item
objectives: Explain request units and consistency levels
Choose between Cosmos DB and Azure SQL

days.topic: Azure DNS, Front Door and CDN
subtopics: Web Application Firewall on Front Door overview
days.lab_task: Serve the App Service app through Front Door with HTTPS and caching for static files, and add a second origin so Front Door fails over when the first is stopped.
days.deliverable: Front Door configuration and failover test results
checks: Front Door serves from the second origin
Second response shows a cache hit
objectives: Deliver apps globally with Front Door

days.topic: Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and Alerts
subtopics: Azure Monitor Agent and data collection rules
days.lab_task: Send VM and App Service logs to a Log Analytics workspace, write KQL queries for errors and top client IPs, and alert by email when CPU stays above 70% for 5 minutes.
days.deliverable: Workspace setup, three KQL queries, alert configuration and the received alert
checks: Run a CPU stress test for 6 minutes
Run the error query after causing 10 errors
Find who deleted a test resource
Activity log shows the user and time
objectives: Collect metrics and logs with Azure Monitor

days.topic: Azure CLI, PowerShell and Scripting
days.lab_task: Write a script that lists all VMs in a subscription with their size and power state, and deallocates those tagged environment=dev.
days.deliverable: Script, output and before and after power states
checks: Lists VMs with size and state in a table
They are deallocated; others are unchanged
Second run makes no changes and does not fail
objectives: Automate Azure with the CLI and PowerShell

days.topic: Azure Functions Serverless
subtopics: Pricing in the Consumption and Flex plans
days.lab_task: Create a function triggered by uploads to a blob container that writes the file name, size and upload time to a Table Storage table using an output binding.
days.deliverable: Function code, binding configuration and table rows for three uploads
checks: Function fails with a clear error in Application Insights

days.topic: Azure Key Vault and Managed Identities
subtopics: Why secrets do not belong in code
Key Vault secrets, keys and certificates
Key Vault references in App Service
days.lab_task: Move the database password into Key Vault, give the web app a managed identity with read access, and use a Key Vault reference so no secret is stored in app settings.
days.deliverable: Key Vault configuration, identity role assignment and app settings showing the reference
checks: Shows a Key Vault reference, not the password
Remove the identity's role and restart the app
App reports it cannot read the secret
Delete the secret and recover it
Secret is restored from soft delete
objectives: Access Azure services with managed identities

days.topic: Infrastructure as Code with Bicep
days.lab_task: Write Bicep files for a storage account and an App Service web app with a module per resource, preview with what-if, deploy, then change a setting and redeploy.
days.deliverable: Bicep files, what-if output and deployment history
checks: Run what-if after changing the SKU
Deployment fails with a clear validation error

days.topic: Containers on Azure: Container Registry and Container Apps
days.lab_task: Push a web app image to ACR, run it in Container Apps pulled with a managed identity, then deploy a new revision and split traffic 80/20.
days.deliverable: Registry, app configuration and traffic split evidence
checks: Roughly 80 go to version 1 and 20 to version 2
Check registry credentials in the app
No admin password is used; managed identity pulls the image
objectives: Store images in Azure Container Registry

days.topic: Cloud Security with Microsoft Defender for Cloud and Azure Policy
subtopics: Defender plans for servers and storage
days.lab_task: Assign a policy that denies storage accounts with public access and one that audits VMs without backup, fix two Defender recommendations, and record the secure score change.
days.deliverable: Policy assignments, compliance results and before and after secure score
checks: Create a storage account with public blob access
VMs without backup are listed as non-compliant
Score improves after the two fixes
objectives: Improve security posture with Defender for Cloud

days.topic: Cost Management and the Azure Well-Architected Framework
days.lab_task: Tag all lab resources, find the three most expensive in cost analysis, propose savings using Advisor, and run a Well-Architected Review of the course web app.
days.deliverable: Cost report with savings proposals and the review summary
checks: Group cost analysis by the project tag
Includes current cost, change and estimated saving
At least three with an improvement each
objectives: Review a workload against best practices

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Highly Available Web Application on Azure
subtopics: Azure SQL with a private endpoint
days.lab_task: Deploy a two-tier web application with App Service, a private Azure SQL database, Front Door, secrets in Key Vault, alerts and a budget, then present it.
days.deliverable: Architecture diagram, deployed application, monitoring workbook, monthly cost estimate and a 10-minute demo
checks: Swap a new version into production during the demo
Try to reach the database from the internet
Monthly estimate from the pricing calculator matches the design
objectives: Design and deploy a highly available web application
Apply identity, networking, security and monitoring together
Present an architecture with its cost

intermediate.summary: For participants who have used core Azure services. Covers landing zones, hub-spoke networking, Terraform and Bicep at scale, AKS, integration services, data services, Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions pipelines, and operations.
prerequisites: Has deployed VMs, storage, VNets, App Service and Azure SQL resources
Comfortable with the Azure CLI and Azure RBAC
Basic Linux command line, Git and Docker
outcomes: Set up governed management groups, subscriptions and hub-spoke networks
Build infrastructure with Bicep and Terraform modules
Run containers on AKS and integration workflows with Service Bus, Event Grid and Logic Apps
Deliver workloads through pipelines with monitoring, Application Insights and cost controls

days.topic: Management Groups, Subscriptions and Landing Zone Concepts
subtopics: Policy initiatives at management group scope
days.lab_task: Build a management group hierarchy for platform and workload subscriptions, assign a policy initiative at the top, and give admins just-in-time Owner rights through PIM.
days.deliverable: Hierarchy diagram, policy assignments and a PIM activation record
checks: Create a resource that breaks the initiative in a workload subscription
Denied or flagged by the inherited policy
Role is active only for the requested time
Try an Owner action without activation
objectives: Design a management group and subscription structure
Apply governance at scale with policy initiatives
Grant privileged access just in time

days.topic: Hub-and-Spoke Networking with Azure Firewall
days.lab_task: Build a hub VNet with Azure Firewall and two spoke VNets, route spoke-to-spoke and internet traffic through the firewall, and allow only approved outbound domains.
days.deliverable: Network diagram, route tables, firewall policy and test results
checks: From spoke A, reach a VM in spoke B
Allowed and visible in firewall logs
From a spoke, browse to an unapproved domain
Resolve a private endpoint name from a spoke
objectives: Inspect and control traffic with Azure Firewall
Resolve private endpoints with Private DNS

days.topic: Terraform for Azure
subtopics: Remote state in Azure Storage with locking
Modules and the Azure Verified Modules library
days.lab_task: Write a Terraform module for a spoke network with subnets and NSGs, store state in a storage account with locking, and deploy dev and prod with different address spaces.
days.deliverable: Module code, environment configurations and plan and apply outputs
checks: Run terraform plan with no changes
Run apply from two terminals at once
Second run waits or fails on the state lock
Resource is in state and plan shows no changes

days.topic: Bicep at Scale: Modules, Registries and Deployment Stacks
days.lab_task: Publish a versioned web-app module to a private Bicep registry, deploy it through a deployment stack with deny settings, and show that manual deletion is blocked.
days.deliverable: Module registry, stack configuration and the blocked deletion evidence
checks: Run the linter with a hard-coded location
objectives: Share Bicep modules through a registry

days.topic: Azure Kubernetes Service Clusters
subtopics: Ingress with Application Gateway for Containers or NGINX
days.lab_task: Create an AKS cluster with system and user node pools, deploy a web app with ingress, and give a pod access to Blob Storage through Workload ID with no stored keys.
days.deliverable: Cluster configuration, manifests and access test results
checks: From the pod, list the allowed container
Succeeds without keys in the pod
From a pod without the identity, list the container
objectives: Grant pods Azure access with Workload ID

days.topic: Integration Services: Service Bus, Event Grid and Logic Apps
days.lab_task: Build an order flow: a function publishes orders to a Service Bus topic, one subscriber function processes payments, a Logic App emails the customer, and failures go to the dead-letter queue.
days.deliverable: Architecture diagram, configuration and test evidence for success and failure
checks: Payment is processed and an email arrives
Submit an order that the processor rejects
Message moves to the dead-letter queue after max deliveries
objectives: Choose between Service Bus, Event Grid and Event Hubs

days.topic: API Management
subtopics: JWT validation with Microsoft Entra ID
days.lab_task: Publish the order API through API Management with JWT validation, a 10-calls-per-minute rate limit and a response transformation, and release a new revision.
days.deliverable: API configuration, policy XML and test results
checks: Call the API without a token
Make 15 calls in a minute with a valid token
Callers get the new behaviour with no URL change
objectives: Publish and protect APIs with API Management
Apply policies for security and throttling

days.topic: Data Services: Azure SQL Tuning, Cosmos DB Patterns and Azure Cache for Redis
subtopics: Cosmos DB partition design for scale
days.lab_task: Fix a slow Azure SQL query using Query Store, add Redis caching in front of it, and use the Cosmos DB change feed to build a read model.
days.deliverable: Before and after query timings, cache configuration and change feed code
checks: Compare query duration before and after the index
Second call is served from Redis
Insert an order in Cosmos DB
Read model updates through the change feed
objectives: Tune Azure SQL with Query Store
Build read models with the change feed

days.topic: CI/CD with Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions
subtopics: Service connections with workload identity federation
GitHub Actions with OIDC to Azure
Deploying to App Service and AKS
days.lab_task: Create a pipeline that authenticates to Azure with workload identity federation (no secrets), builds and pushes an image to ACR, deploys to dev, and waits for approval before prod.
days.deliverable: Pipeline YAML, service connection configuration and two pipeline runs
checks: Uses workload identity federation with no client secret
Image is built and deployed to dev
Prod is updated only after approval

days.topic: Deployment Strategies: Slots, Revisions and Blue/Green on Azure
subtopics: App Service slot swaps with auto swap
days.lab_task: Release a Container Apps revision as a 10% canary with a feature flag in App Configuration, watch error metrics, and roll back when errors rise.
days.deliverable: Release configuration, metrics and evidence of a rollback
checks: Traffic moves to 100% after checks pass
Errors are detected and traffic returns to the old revision
objectives: Run canary releases and roll back
Separate releases from deployments with feature flags

days.topic: Application Insights and Distributed Tracing
days.lab_task: Instrument the order flow with OpenTelemetry, view one order across the function, Service Bus and API, add an availability test, and build a service workbook.
days.deliverable: Application map, workbook and availability test results
checks: One end-to-end transaction is visible across services
Availability test fails and an alert fires

days.topic: Workload Protection: WAF, DDoS Protection and Microsoft Sentinel
subtopics: Web Application Firewall on Front Door and Application Gateway
Managed rule sets and custom rules
days.lab_task: Protect the app with WAF managed rules and a rate limit, connect Azure activity and WAF logs to Sentinel, and write an analytics rule that creates an incident for repeated blocks.
days.deliverable: WAF policy, Sentinel rule and the generated incident
checks: Send a SQL injection test string
Send 500 requests a minute from one IP
objectives: Collect and analyse security logs in Sentinel

days.topic: Backup, Site Recovery and Business Continuity
subtopics: Azure Backup for VMs and files
days.lab_task: Set RPO and RTO for the app, replicate its VM with Site Recovery, add an Azure SQL failover group, and run a timed test failover to the paired region.
days.deliverable: Continuity plan, configuration and the test failover timeline
checks: App works in the secondary region
Compare measured recovery with the RTO
Within the RTO or the gap is explained
Restore a single file from backup
objectives: Protect workloads with Backup and Site Recovery

days.topic: Operations with Azure Automation and Update Manager
days.lab_task: Patch all dev VMs in a maintenance window with Update Manager and write a runbook that restarts the web service on a schedule and checks its health.
days.deliverable: Patch compliance report, runbook code and job history
checks: Open update compliance after the window
Service restarts and the health check passes
Stop the service manually and wait for the schedule

days.topic: Cost Optimisation for Running Azure Workloads
days.lab_task: Reduce the monthly cost of the course workload by at least 30% with rightsizing, autoscale schedules, storage tiering and Spot where safe, measuring before and after.
days.deliverable: Cost analysis with before and after estimates and the changes made
checks: Reduction of at least 30% or a documented reason
Evict a Spot VM in the test
objectives: Measure costs per unit of work
Apply compute and storage cost savings

days.topic: Hybrid and Migration with Azure Migrate and Azure Arc
days.lab_task: Assess a simulated on-premises environment with Azure Migrate, migrate a SQL Server database online to Azure SQL, and onboard a non-Azure server with Arc for policy and monitoring.
days.deliverable: Assessment report, migration timeline and Arc server compliance view
checks: View the Arc server in the portal
Policy compliance and monitoring data appear
objectives: Manage hybrid servers with Azure Arc

days.topic: Analytics with Microsoft Fabric and Azure Data Factory
subtopics: Copy activity and mapping data flows
days.lab_task: Build a Data Factory pipeline that copies daily sales files from Blob Storage into a Fabric lakehouse table, runs on a schedule, and alerts on failure.
days.deliverable: Pipeline definition, run history and lakehouse query results
checks: Run the pipeline for one day's files
Row count in the table matches the files
Pipeline fails or routes the bad file as designed and alerts
objectives: Move data with Data Factory pipelines
Store analytics data in a Fabric lakehouse

days.topic: Azure OpenAI and AI Services Integration
days.lab_task: Add a question-answering feature to the web app using Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Search over the course FAQs, authenticated with managed identity over private endpoints.
days.deliverable: Feature code, configuration and answers for 10 test questions
checks: Answers cite the correct FAQ entries
Ask a question outside the FAQ
App says it does not know instead of inventing an answer
No API keys are stored; managed identity is used
objectives: Integrate Azure OpenAI into an application
Ground answers with Azure AI Search
Secure AI services with identity and private access

days.topic: Governance: Azure Policy as Code and Compliance Reporting
days.lab_task: Store custom policies in Git, deploy them through a pipeline, add a Modify policy that applies a required tag automatically, and report compliance with Resource Graph.
days.deliverable: Policy repository, pipeline run and the compliance report
checks: Create a resource without the required tag

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Event-Driven Order Platform on Azure
subtopics: AKS or Container Apps services with Service Bus
days.lab_task: Build an event-driven order platform with API Management, containerised services, Service Bus, Cosmos DB, managed identities, infrastructure as code and a canary pipeline, then present it.
days.deliverable: Repository, architecture diagram, workbook, cost estimate and a 15-minute demo
checks: Order completes across services and is traced in Application Insights
Canary detects errors and rolls back
Delete and redeploy the environment from code
Environment is rebuilt with no manual steps
objectives: Design and build an event-driven platform end to end
Combine infrastructure as code, pipelines, security and monitoring

advanced.summary: For experienced Azure engineers. Covers enterprise landing zones, multi-region resilience, identity and security at scale, platform engineering, AKS fleets, FinOps, compliance and architecture reviews.
prerequisites: Two or more years building and operating workloads on Azure
Has used infrastructure as code, pipelines and containers in production
AZ-104 or AZ-204 level knowledge or equivalent experience
outcomes: Design enterprise landing zones and multi-region Azure architectures that meet stated goals
Build platforms and guardrails that teams can self-serve
Run security, cost and reliability programmes with measurable results
Lead architecture reviews and justify trade-offs with evidence

days.topic: Enterprise-Scale Landing Zone Implementation
days.lab_task: Deploy an Azure landing zone for a company with three business units using the Terraform accelerator, and automate vending of a new application subscription with baseline networking and policy.
days.deliverable: Landing zone design, automation code and a vended subscription
checks: Vend a new subscription through the pipeline
Subscription has baseline network, policy and logging
Each group has a stated purpose and policy set
Deploy a non-compliant resource in the new subscription

days.topic: Multi-Region Active-Active Architecture on Azure
subtopics: When active-active is worth the cost
Cosmos DB multi-region writes and conflict policies
days.lab_task: Build an active-active API in two regions with Cosmos DB multi-region writes and Front Door, simulate loss of one region, and measure the impact on reads and writes.
days.deliverable: Architecture decision record, deployment and the failure test report
checks: Write the same item in both regions at once
Conflict is resolved as configured and explained
Traffic moves to the other within the stated time
Extra cost compared with one region is quantified

days.topic: Resilience Engineering with Azure Chaos Studio
days.lab_task: Run three Chaos Studio experiments (zone loss for VMs, AKS pod failures, Cosmos DB failover) against the course service, and fix one weakness each experiment reveals.
days.deliverable: Experiment definitions, results and the resilience improvements
checks: Service stays within its error budget
Faults are removed and the service recovers
objectives: Design for failure with stamps and health models

days.topic: Identity Architecture: Conditional Access and Workload Identities
subtopics: Workload identity federation for external systems
days.lab_task: Design Conditional Access for admins and developers, require phishing-resistant MFA for privileged roles, federate a GitHub workflow identity, and set quarterly access reviews.
days.deliverable: Identity design, policies and test results
checks: Admin signs in without the required authentication strength
Unused access is removed after review
objectives: Design identity controls for people and workloads

days.topic: Security Operations at Scale with Defender XDR and Sentinel
days.lab_task: Automate response to a simulated compromised VM: isolate it with an NSG, snapshot its disks, disable the managed identity, and open an incident with the evidence.
days.deliverable: Playbook, runbook and the incident timeline
checks: Disk snapshots exist and are tagged with the incident ID
Run a hunting query for related sign-ins

days.topic: Data Protection: Encryption, Key Management and Confidential Computing
days.lab_task: Apply customer-managed keys to storage and Azure SQL for confidential data, classify data with Purview, and prove that disabling a key blocks access.
days.deliverable: Encryption design, configuration and access test results
checks: Storage access fails until the key is enabled
objectives: Design key management for regulated data

days.topic: Platform Engineering on Azure with Golden Paths
days.lab_task: Build a golden-path template that creates a containerised service with repository, pipeline, Container Apps environment, monitoring and alerts in one self-service request.
days.deliverable: Template code, a service created from it and a platform scorecard
checks: Create a service from the template
Repository, pipeline, infrastructure and workbook exist and the service deploys
Under the target in the scorecard
objectives: Design internal platforms around golden paths

days.topic: AKS Fleet Management and Multi-Tenancy
subtopics: Network policies with Azure CNI powered by Cilium
days.lab_task: Configure a multi-tenant AKS cluster for three teams with quotas and network policies, and use Fleet Manager to roll an upgrade across two clusters in stages.
days.deliverable: Cluster configuration, tenant policies and the staged upgrade record
checks: Team A pod calls a Team B service
Second cluster upgrades only after the first passes checks
objectives: Manage many clusters with Fleet Manager

days.topic: GitOps with Flux and Progressive Delivery on AKS
subtopics: Secrets with the Key Vault CSI driver
days.lab_task: Manage two AKS clusters with Flux and release a service with a Flagger canary that promotes or rolls back based on Prometheus error-rate analysis.
days.deliverable: GitOps repository, canary configuration and two release histories

days.topic: Serverless and Integration at Scale
days.lab_task: Load test the order workflow to 2,000 messages per second, find the first limit, and redesign with partitioning, Durable Functions and idempotency until it meets the latency target.
days.deliverable: Load test reports, limits found and the redesign with results
checks: Run the load test before the redesign
First limit is identified with evidence
objectives: Find and handle scaling limits in serverless and messaging

days.topic: Enterprise Integration Patterns and Event Architecture
days.lab_task: Implement the outbox pattern with Cosmos DB change feed and Service Bus across two subscriptions, version an event schema without breaking consumers, and replay archived events.
days.deliverable: Architecture, code, schema versions and replay evidence
checks: Fail the publisher after the database write
Event is still delivered later through the outbox

days.topic: Data Platform Architecture with Fabric and Databricks
days.lab_task: Build bronze, silver and gold layers for sales data with Delta tables, apply column-level access in Unity Catalog, add data quality checks, and compare the cost of two compute options.
days.deliverable: Lakehouse design, notebooks, access rules, quality results and cost comparison
checks: Load a batch that breaks a quality rule
Bad rows are quarantined as designed
Time travel returns the earlier data
objectives: Design a governed lakehouse on Azure
Compare compute options by cost and speed

days.topic: FinOps Practice on Azure
subtopics: Cost exports to a data store
days.lab_task: Build a chargeback report per business unit from cost exports with the FinOps toolkit and Power BI, define a cost-per-order metric, and recommend a savings plan purchase.
days.deliverable: Chargeback report, unit cost metric and commitment recommendation
checks: Compare chargeback totals with the invoice
objectives: Run FinOps reporting and chargeback on Azure

days.topic: Compliance Automation and Audit Readiness on Azure
subtopics: Regulatory compliance in Defender for Cloud
Policy checks in pipelines with PSRule
days.lab_task: Map 10 controls from a chosen framework to policies and pipeline checks, add automated remediation for two, and produce an audit evidence report.
days.deliverable: Control mapping, policies, remediation code and evidence report
checks: Push a template that breaks a PSRule rule

days.topic: Performance Engineering for Azure Workloads
days.lab_task: Bring a slow API from 900 ms to under 200 ms p95 at the target load using Azure Load Testing, Application Insights and database tuning, documenting each change and its measured effect.
days.deliverable: Performance report with each change and its effect, and the final load test
checks: p95 under 200 ms at target load
Show the slowest dependency before and after
Add a failure criterion to the load test
Test fails when latency exceeds the target

days.topic: Production Generative AI on Azure AI Foundry
subtopics: Retrieval-augmented generation with Azure AI Search
days.lab_task: Build a RAG assistant over the course runbooks with network isolation, content safety, an evaluation set of 20 questions, and dashboards for tokens and latency.
days.deliverable: Assistant code, safety configuration, evaluation results and the dashboard
checks: Groundedness and relevance meet the stated thresholds
Call the endpoint from outside the private network
objectives: Build production RAG applications on Azure
Apply content safety and network isolation

days.topic: Large-Scale Migration and Modernisation Strategy on Azure
days.lab_task: Produce a migration plan for a 60-application portfolio: classify each by strategy, plan three waves with dependencies, and write the business case for wave 1.
days.deliverable: Portfolio analysis, wave plan and business case
checks: No application moves before its dependencies
Includes costs, savings, risks and payback

days.topic: SRE Practice on Azure: SLOs, Error Budgets and Incident Command
days.lab_task: Define SLOs for the order API, build burn-rate alerts, and run a 60-minute incident simulation with assigned roles followed by a post-incident review.
days.deliverable: SLO document, alert rules, incident timeline and review
checks: Inject errors that burn 10% of the budget in an hour
Roles, decisions and customer updates are recorded
Root cause and at least three owned actions
objectives: Lead incidents and learn from them

days.topic: Azure Architecture Reviews and Trade-off Decisions
subtopics: Reference architectures in the Azure Architecture Center
days.lab_task: Review another team's capstone design with the Well-Architected Review, write two architecture decision records for its biggest risks, and present recommendations.
days.deliverable: Review report, two decision records and a 10-minute presentation
checks: Each high risk has evidence and a recommendation
Lists options, criteria and the reason for the choice
Participant defends it with cost and risk evidence

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Multi-Region Enterprise Platform on Azure
